resources.name: Experimental enthalpies of formation for reference compounds

access.notes: Gas-phase enthalpies of formation for CH4, H2O, MeOOH, Me2CHOOH, Bu^tOOH, Bu^tOH, C6H6, PhCH3, PhOH, HOOH as listed in the paper's Table 3. These are well-known experimental values accessible at NIST Webbook or equivalent standard reference.
